map.CPI 和 PPI 区别？: What is the difference between CPI and PPI?
map.CPI 测消费端一篮子价格、PPI 测生产端，传导有滞后，口径不同。结果仅作经济: CPI measures a consumer basket of prices while PPI measures the producer side; the pass-through lags and the two have different coverage. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation only; they are not investment advice or a policy basis, and for forecasts and empirical estimates defer to official statistics and textbooks.
map.CPI 下降即通缩，连续通缩伴需求疲软，需政策应对。结果仅作经济学教学与快速测算: A falling CPI is deflation; persistent deflation comes with weak demand and needs a policy response. map.通货膨胀率=(现期价格水平−基期价格水平)/基期×100%，衡量一段时期物价总体: Inflation rate = (current price level − base-period price level) / base period × 100%, measuring the overall rise in prices over a period.
map.常用 CPI 同比（与去年同月比）或环比（与上月比）。结果为正表示通胀、负表示通: Commonly CPI year on year (versus the same month last year) or month on month (versus last month). A positive result means inflation, a negative one deflation.
map.不同篮子与基期所得结果不同；单月波动受季节性与临时冲击影响，宜结合趋势研判。: Different baskets and base periods give different results; monthly swings reflect seasonality and temporary shocks, so judge against the trend.
